review.summary: The public API satisfies B1-B29 and B31 by source inspection, but B30 is not satisfied: command(30) returns undefined instead of 30. Runtime evidence covers only command(1), but the complete source establishes the remaining deterministic behavior.

findings.problem: command(30) dispatches to value30, whose implementation returns undefined. Therefore the public exported command(30) returns undefined rather than the required number 30.
findings.nextAction: Change value30 to return 30, then verify command(30).
